freeze.prior_outcome_exposure: Cohort2 outcomes known; cohort1 expression outcomes unexamined. Originalpanels andcomparisongate frozenbeforeboth.

inference: Same-study cross-cohort direction comparator. Cohort1 is 18-20 months/all male/10x v3.0; cohort2 old animals are 24-26 months/mixed sex/10x v3.1. Shared named annotations have different cluster collapses. This is not exact replication or an independent study.
scope_limits: The observed contrast bundles doxycycline exposure with OSKM induction. BL6 doxycycline-only controls are absent from these processed objects, so drug and construct effects cannot be separated.
CPM and median-ratio agreement checks sensitivity to these size-factor choices; it does not establish absolute RNA changes or eliminate compositional effects.
Animal-level destructive snapshots and small animal counts support descriptive marker-score comparisons; they do not establish rejuvenation, function, recovery, retinal efficacy or safety.
Author sample labels encode DOB20180508 for both treated animals and DOB20180501 for both controls. Date of birth differs with condition; litter membership is unconfirmed and is not inferred.

All four animals share one multiplexed library. Cohort1 differs from cohort2 in age range, sex composition, chemistry and annotation collapses; same-direction means are weaker than animal-level consistency.
